item: The style non-growth ratchet ceiling drops from 417 to 412 (zero slack on main 3af9f1fc9)
summary: scripts/ruff_ratchet.py, run at the old ceiling on main 3af9f1fc9 with ruff 0.17.3 (the newest release pyproject's range allows after #1456), said the ceiling can be lowered to 412; the ci.yml step now says 412. The count depends on the tool version: the same tree reads 414 on ruff 0.16.9 and 412 on 0.17.3. CI measures the merge of the PR into the base tip as it stands when the run starts, so a finding another PR lands first reddens the next run of whichever PR merges second. scripts/guards_for_diff.py reads the ceiling from ci.yml, so a pre-push run picks up 412 once main is merged in. The other 417s in the tree are test fixtures (tests/test_ruff_ratchet.py, tests/test_guards_for_diff.py) and dated ledger history, not a second copy of the ceiling.
